calibration.covariance_limit: perturbation repeatability is not localization accuracy
calibration.failure_policy: every failed attempt stays in case/PCK/AUC denominators; NME conditional on complete cases is labeled
calibration.rater_agreement_limit: disagreement needs at least two raters; zero with one rater is not evidence of agreement
calibration.reference_limit: errors are relative to recorded annotations; blinding is declared, not independently attested
